answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require stake-backed identity: before trading, every agent locks a deposit in a shared vault, and the vault mirrors each agent reputation across markets, so one operator running a thousand sock-puppets must fund a thousand separate deposits. Honest agents slowly earn their stake back plus fees; cheaters forfeit it. Forgery stops being free and becomes a costly gamble, and the oasis of cheap fake identities dries up, because every new fake costs real capital that stays locked and at risk.
